in_marathi.name: Chandraaditya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon and Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandraaditya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandraaditya is a Sanskrit name that means 'Moon and Sun'. This name embodies the eternal balance and interconnectedness of these celestial bodies. In Hindu mythology, Chandra, the Moon, and Aditya, the Sun, are revered deities. The name Chandraaditya signifies the harmony and unity of these two powerful entities.
